name: New York University
description: New York University is a private research university founded in 1831, centred on Washington Square in Manhattan, with degree-granting campuses in Abu Dhabi and Shanghai. Its schools include the Stern School of Business, Tandon School of Engineering and the School of Law.
whyIncluded: Its medical and law degrees are both recognised for practice in Singapore (Singapore Medical Council and Singapore Institute of Legal Education lists). One of the 10 universities in the US most popular with international students; the US is one of the nine places Singaporeans most often study abroad (about 3,800 Singaporean students, UNESCO data).

livingCosts.summary: NYU's own estimate for a New York undergraduate's 9-month academic year: food and housing (shown together), transport, books and personal costs. Tuition and health insurance are extra.
livingCosts.notes: NYU Admissions 'Cost of Attendance' 2026-2027, New York campus, fall + spring: Food and Housing US$26,438 (combined, so all under housing; food 0); Transportation US$2,438; personal = Books and Supplies US$1,492 + Personal Expenses US$2,054 = US$3,546. Tandon's graduate estimate (9 credits) is higher: food US$6,910, housing US$24,414.

programmes.name: BS in Mechanical Engineering (Tandon School of Engineering)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition and mandatory registration fees for NYU undergraduates in New York, quoted as one figure. Health insurance not included; fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: NYU Bulletins 'Cost of Attendance' 2026-2027, New York campus undergraduate direct costs: 'Tuition and Fees' US$68,576 for most schools (CAS, Tandon, Steinhardt, Meyers and others) (the same table is on the admissions cost-of-attendance page and the Silver School bulletin PDF). The page gives one combined tuition-and-fees figure (registration and services fees included), so the whole amount is recorded as tuition and compulsory fees as 0. The bulletin says the amounts were not officially approved until July 2026. Health insurance excluded: NYU publishes an F-1/J-1 student health insurance waiver form, so it can be waived with qualifying coverage. NYU's Bursar tuition PDFs (2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27) refuse automated reading, so no earlier-year figures were taken and there is no feeHistory. Not cohort-locked. Retried 2026-10-13: the bursar 'Tuition' page lists 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 Tuition and Fees PDFs but exposes no readable link to them, the NYU Bulletins archive (bulletins.nyu.edu/archive/...) is blocked to automated reading, and the school cost pages (Stern, Law, Grossman, Steinhardt, bulletins) show 2026-27 only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2024 row (2026-10-13, unofficial): SoFi's NYU tuition page (updated 08/2025, IPEDS-based) states 'NYU tuition and fees is $62,796 for the 2024-25 school year' (CollegeTuitionCompare and Univstats give the same 2024-2025 figure); this is NYU's standard undergraduate rate, recorded as combined tuition and fees like the current figure. 2025 not filled: Washington Square News (25 Jun 2025) says tuition is 'now around $68,575' after a 4.25% rise 'next year', which equals the 2026-27 bulletin figure recorded here rather than a distinct 2025-26 rate, so the year is ambiguous and it was not used; aggregators give only an estimate for 2025-26. 2025 row (2026-10-13, rung 4): Niche's NYU cost page (IPEDS-based) and Orbit's NYU tuition page ('$65,622 tuition in the 2026 public cost data', https://www.findmyorbit.com/tuition-fees/new-york-university) both give NYU undergraduate tuition and fees of US$65,622; NYU's own NYU Shanghai cost-of-attendance page (cdn.shanghai.nyu.edu/page/cost-attendance), headed 2025-2026, states 'Tuition $65,622', and the NYU Shanghai bulletin's 2026-27 tuition (US$68,576) equals the New York standard rate recorded here, so the figure is NYU's 2025-26 standard undergraduate rate; it differs from the 2024-25 (US$62,796) and 2026-27 (US$68,576) figures. Recorded as combined tuition and fees like the current figure.

programmes.summary: Yearly JD tuition plus NYU's health, registration, service and technology fees. Health insurance not included. Fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: NYU Law 'Student Expense Budget' 2026-27, JD: Tuition US$87,312; Health, Registration, Service, and Tech Fees US$3,326. Health Insurance (basic) US$4,952 excluded. NYU's JD is on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's approved list (Fifth Schedule, Legal Profession (Qualified Persons) Rules; graduates in the top 70% of their batch). NYU's Bursar tuition PDFs (2024-25, 2025-26, 2026-27) refuse automated reading, so no earlier-year figures were taken and there is no feeHistory. Retried 2026-10-13: the bursar 'Tuition' page lists 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 Tuition and Fees PDFs but exposes no readable link to them, the NYU Bulletins archive (bulletins.nyu.edu/archive/...) is blocked to automated reading, and the school cost pages (Stern, Law, Grossman, Steinhardt, bulletins) show 2026-27 only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2025 row (2026-10-13): NYU Law's own 2025 ABA Standard 509 Information Report (generated 15 Dec 2025) gives 2025-2026 full-time tuition US$83,952 and fees US$3,262 (resident and nonresident alike). 2024 not filled: NYU's ABA disclosure page now links only the 2025 report and the 2024 report was not found at a guessable address; LST Reports is blocked to automated reading. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): a guessed 2024 report address (sites/default/files/2024-12/Std509InfoReport_2024.pdf) failed, and LSAT Lab and Odyssey Test Prep give only the 2025 and 2023-24 figures. 2024 row (2026-10-13, rung 3): the Top-Law-Schools wiki page on NYU Law (edited 26 Aug 2026) gives the 2024-25 budget as tuition US$79,954 and health, registration, service and technology fees US$3,198 (same components as the current figure); it sits below NYU Law's own 2025-26 509 figures (US$83,952 and US$3,262), so it was accepted as a dated third-party figure. No second source for this figure was found. Fix 2026-10-15: SILE's separate US approved-universities page now redirects to a generic page; the Fifth Schedule list is on the 'Qualified Person (Overseas Scheduled Universities)' page under its United States of America tab, where this university is listed (Fifth Schedule, J.D., top 70% of the graduating batch, degree conferred on or after 1 January 2004). Source: https://www.sile.edu.sg/for-overseas-graduates/qualified-person/#unitedstatesofamerica (read 2026-10-15).

programmes.notes: NYU Steinhardt 'Graduate Study Tuition and Fees' 2026-2027: tuition US$2,363 per credit; registration/service fee US$584 for the first credit each term + US$81 per additional credit. Retried 2026-10-13: the bursar 'Tuition' page lists 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 Tuition and Fees PDFs but exposes no readable link to them, the NYU Bulletins archive (bulletins.nyu.edu/archive/...) is blocked to automated reading, and the school cost pages (Stern, Law, Grossman, Steinhardt, bulletins) show 2026-27 only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 4): Steinhardt department pages (counseling.steinhardt.nyu.edu, steinhardt.nyu.edu/node/4836) show the 2026-27 rate only. Round 5 (2026-10-13): the archived 2024-2025 NYU Bulletin Steinhardt graduate 'Tuition 2024-2025' gives tuition $2,185 per unit per term and registration and services fee $560 for the first unit + $77 per additional unit; on the current basis (24 credits a year in two 12-credit terms) 2024 = 24 x $2,185 = $52,440 tuition and ($560 + 11 x $77) x 2 = $2,814 fees; 2024 row added. 2025 still unfilled: NYU Bulletins has an archived 2024-2025 edition (bulletins.nyu.edu/archive/2024-2025/, readable with curl) but no 2025-2026 archive (/archive/2025-2026/ returns 404) and the live bulletin shows 2026-27. Round 6 (2026-10-13): 2025 row added. NYU Steinhardt's own EdD in Leadership and Innovation tuition page (leadershipinnovation.steinhardt.nyu.edu/tuition/, read with curl) still lists the '2025–2026 Academic Year: $2,272 Tuition per point/credit ... $79 Registration/service fee for each additional credit' next to the 2026-27 $2,363 (the Steinhardt-wide rate in the current bulletin), so 2025 tuition = 24 x $2,272 = $54,528. That page's first-credit fee ($466) is specific to that online programme; the standard Steinhardt first-credit fee for 2025-26 is $571 per term in search-engine copies of the 2025-26 graduate bulletin and Steinhardt counseling page (both since overwritten with 2026-27 figures; skillnation.in gives $572), so fees = ($571 + 11 x $79) x 2 = $2,880 (within $2 of the alternative). NYU Bursar PDFs (/content/dam/nyu/bursar/documents/2025-2026 Tuition and Fees.pdf) are linked from the bursar page but return Apache 403 to curl and to a headless browser. Round 6 review (2026-10-13): the 2025 row's compulsory fees were dropped because part of that figure came only from search-engine copies of overwritten pages; the row now uses the current registration and service fees.
